scope.control: Distinct prospective finite model with photon Thomson collision switched off.
scope.charge_fraction: Y_i divided by its fixed initial isotope inventory; no diagnostic renormalization; n/T zero-inventory fractions are null.
scope.tau_off: Potential electron-column Thomson depth from this trajectory, integrated from z20; not applied collision depth.
scope.gamma_T_per_H_off: Electron-derived diagnostic remains nonzero; applied operator is zero.
scope.indirect_feedback: Neutrino, chemistry and geometry trajectories may change indirectly. Instantaneous gamma-only wiring does not imply identical full neutrino histories.
